comment: The gate states are plain members rather than parameters, so unlike Mesoglea's they are not written into the patch file and every row comes up closed on load. The TOMUTE jacks and the OUTPUT jacks carry whatever is patched in and are given no family. The AND/OR logic is the same routine as Mesohyl's: in OR mode only the jacks that are actually patched get a vote, so one patched jack rules the row.
